evidence.title: A 6-Step Marketing Strategy Template for Ecommerce Startups

name: A 6-Step Marketing Strategy Template for Ecommerce Startups
summary: Blog post on a six-step ecommerce marketing strategy: audience, landing pages, competitor analysis, platforms, experiments, framework.
description: Agency blog post, credited to a Marketing Masala infographic, that walks ecommerce startups through defining a target audience, designing landing pages with clear calls to action, running competitive analysis, choosing marketing platforms, running and validating experiments, and building a marketing framework. Includes practical tips for landing-page design and platform selection.
